name: Smiley
s: In Smiley , Álex is heartbroken. He was building fantasies with a boy that, a couple of weeks later, disappeared giving him a textbook ghosting. And he is really upset because of it. He picks up the phone and asks out for an explanation in a voicemail that will have unexpected consequences... because he ends up sending it by mistake to Bruno, whom he doesn't know at all. This innocent first …

paragraphs.text: Smiley is a Spanish romantic comedy television series based on the play of the same name by Guillem Clua which stars Carlos Cuevas and Miki Esparbé. It was released on Netflix on 7 December 2022.
